title: zazzled source component diagram
description: The parts of the zazzled crate's source. Three front ends (the socket server, the MCP server and in-process run) feed command lines to the commands, which run on one shared engine; the MCP proxy and `zazzle run` are separate subcommands of the same binary that reuse clean's steps. clean, `zazzle run` and the proxy keep their outputs in the output store, from which read-again gives them back. The `zazz` command line goes to the zazz scripts module, which builds, tests and runs scripts in zazz-worker processes and adds its tools to the MCP server. All of it is one binary.

components.name: zazzled source
components.responsibility: The zazzled library and binary.

components.name: Command line (main.rs, cli.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses `zazzled serve|mcp|proxy|wrap|install|uninstall|run|version`, opens the engine with its cache and output store and starts the chosen front end, or hands proxy and wrap to their folders.

components.name: Socket server (server.rs)
components.responsibility: Binds the private socket (or takes launchd's), serves connections on 2 to 8 worker threads (script calls and human runs on a thread of their own), checks the peer's uid, receives the request and passed descriptors, runs the command with copies of the caller's streams for a script to use, and answers; flushes the cache every 100 ms and exits when idle.

components.name: Wire format (proto.rs)
components.responsibility: Encodes and decodes the length-prefixed request, limits its size, and does the relay round trip.

components.name: Socket client (client.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds the socket path, calls the daemon in relay mode, and starts `zazzled serve` and retries when no daemon is listening.

components.name: MCP server (mcp.rs, mcp_structure.rs)
components.responsibility: Answers newline-delimited JSON-RPC on standard input and output: initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call for twenty tools (seven zazzle file tools, six structure tools answered by the indexer, and the seven zazz script tools the zazz module defines), each call forwarded to the daemon under one session per connection.

components.name: launchd integration (launchd.rs)
components.responsibility: Takes the socket launchd opened, writes and loads or unloads the LaunchAgent, and runs external programs with a timeout.

components.name: Engine (engine.rs, meta.rs)
components.responsibility: Shared daemon state: loads files with their metadata (BLAKE3 hash, line starts, binary, minified and CRLF flags; line anchors on demand), keeps a hot cache validated by stat, gives ls and find a light summary without hashing, caches outlines by content hash, holds the walk cache, the session table, the output store's directory, the edit lock, the counters and the zazz state (script store, worker binary and warm workers).

components.name: Persistent cache (store.rs)
components.responsibility: The append-only log of per-path summaries under the cache directory: checksums, torn-tail repair, compaction on open, flushed by the server.

components.name: Walker (walk.rs)
components.responsibility: Lists the files under a root honouring .gitignore, .ignore and git's exclude file, applies globs, and reuses a listing while every directory and ignore file keeps its stat, checked on the pool.

components.name: Outliner (outline.rs, arena.rs)
components.responsibility: Symbols with line ranges: tree-sitter for Rust, Python, C, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript and TSX up to 1 MiB, its allocations in a per-thread arena during each parse; headings, tables and keys for Markdown, TOML and JSON; keywords and indentation for the rest.

components.name: Symbol finder (symbols.rs)
components.responsibility: Resolves a symbol name or qualified name, with optional parameter types, to one outline symbol, lists candidates otherwise, and finds the comments and attributes above it.

components.name: Parameter lists (params.rs)
components.responsibility: Splits a query's `Name(T1, T2)` and a declaration's parameter list, and compares them by type, or by name for untyped parameters.

components.name: Markup terse view (markup.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of HTML and Razor files in the indexer's line format: hides long comments, <style> and <svg> elements, head tag runs and Razor @using runs, and shortens long class and style values.

components.name: Stylesheet terse view (styles.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of CSS, SCSS, Sass and Less files line by line, in the indexer's line format, with markup.rs's Plan: hides long comments, source map comments, import runs, @font-face and @keyframes blocks, vendor-prefixed duplicates and SCSS @debug lines, and shortens inline data URIs.

components.name: Nim terse view (nim.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of Nim files line by line, since no tree-sitter grammar for Nim parses enough of it: hides runs of top-level imports, indented one-line logging calls without side effects and region comments, leaving lines in triple-quoted strings alone.

components.name: SQL terse view (sql.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of SQL files line by line: hides region comments and collapses the middle rows of an INSERT .. VALUES list of 6+ rows that each sit alone on their lines.

components.name: COBOL terse view (cobol.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of COBOL files line by line with markup.rs's Plan: drops fixed-format sequence and identification areas, collapses comment blocks and COPY runs, and hides debugging lines.

components.name: Data terse view (data.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of JSON, YAML and TOML files line by line with markup.rs's Plan: collapses runs of 10+ list items (multi-line ones only when they name the same keys), lock file entries and 6+ TOML [[tables]] to their first and last, long comment blocks, YAML block scalars and TOML multi-line strings, and shortens quoted strings over 120 characters.

components.name: Markdown terse view (md.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of Markdown files line by line with markup.rs's Plan: hides HTML comments, badge lines, link reference definitions and tables of contents, leaving fenced code and front matter alone.

components.name: XML terse view (xml.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of XML files line by line with markup.rs's Plan: collapses comments of 3+ lines and runs of 10+ sibling elements with the same tag to their first and last, and cuts long values and blobs.

components.name: INI and Dockerfile terse view (config.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of INI-style files and Dockerfiles line by line with markup.rs's Plan: collapses comment blocks of 4+ lines, Dockerfile LABEL runs and package lists in continued RUN instructions, and cuts long values.

components.name: HCL, Protobuf and GraphQL terse view (schema.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of HCL/Terraform, Protobuf and GraphQL files line by line with markup.rs's Plan: collapses comments and GraphQL descriptions of 3+ lines, HCL heredoc bodies, Protobuf import and option runs, and runs of 10+ enum values or HCL list and map items, and cuts long values.

components.name: Code terse view (terse.rs)
components.responsibility: Builds the terse view of Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Perl, Lua, Elixir, Haskell, OCaml, F#, Clojure, Erlang, R, Julia, Zig, Objective-C, Groovy, PowerShell, Visual Basic, Fortran, Pascal and shell files with tree-sitter, in the indexer's line format: hides imports, logging, region markers, constructors that only store parameters, catches that only log and rethrow and Go `if err != nil` returns, and drops TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, PHP and Scala access modifiers.

components.name: Language modules (modules.rs)
components.responsibility: Loads every tree-sitter grammar from language modules: parses the manifest compiled into the binary, downloads a missing module from icelander.net when JIT is on, checks its SHA-256, stores it in ~/.zazzle/v1/languages and opens it with dlopen, checking the module format and tree-sitter ABI; caches loaded grammars for the process and failures for a minute.

components.name: Short locals (locals.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds each function's locals of 6+ characters in a Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Perl, Lua, Elixir, Zig, Objective-C, Groovy or shell syntax tree and, when every place the name appears can be renamed safely, gives it the C# view's short name at its declaration and every use.

components.name: Thread pool (pool.rs)
components.responsibility: One pool of threads per process, started on first use; par_map runs borrowed work on the caller and pool helpers and returns results in item order.

components.name: C# indexer bridge (indexer.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds zazzle-csharp-indexer and its state directory, starts its daemon when nothing listens, says hello with the indexer's version and the git work tree, asks its `view` tool for a C# file's terse view and its structure tools for overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame and report_gap, and rewrites root:path references for the working directory.

components.name: Session table (session.rs)
components.responsibility: Gives each response a short id per session, replaces a repeat within the window by an "already sent" notice, and remembers the request behind each id for read-again.

components.name: Output store (outputs.rs)
components.responsibility: Keeps outputs that cannot be produced again (clean, run, proxy) on disk under a ten-character id derived from their text: the text shown and the full input, in an owner-only directory; each save drops entries older than an hour and, past the size limit, the oldest until half the bytes remain.

components.name: Helpers (args.rs, tokens.rs, util.rs)
components.responsibility: Flag parsing with one-line errors, token estimates, path display and resolution, ranking and line clipping.

components.name: zazzle commands
components.responsibility: find, read, ls, outline, refs, edit, clean, read-again and status.

components.name: MCP proxy
components.responsibility: `zazzled proxy`: cleans another MCP server's results, over stdio or Streamable HTTP.

components.name: zazzle run
components.responsibility: `zazzled wrap`: runs a command and prints its output cleaned with a profile.

components.name: zazz scripts
components.responsibility: `zazz ...`: packs, builds, tests once, registers and runs sandboxed scripts by hash, installs them as commands, and signs and trusts them; the MCP tools zazz_new, zazz_test, zazz_pack, zazz_add, zazz_call, zazz_describe and zazz_ls.

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: macOS's service manager: owns the socket of an installed LaunchAgent and starts `zazzled serve` on the first connection; driven with launchctl.

components.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer
components.responsibility: The C# tool in this repository whose daemon answers `view` and the structure tools over its own unix socket; it lists no tools to clients.

components.name: zazz-worker
components.responsibility: The WebAssembly host binary in this repository that compiles, tests and runs scripts, started by the zazz module.
